meta.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity

sub.title: God of Thunder
sub.description: Ichigo, Orihime and Chad head out to defeat Yhwach while Yoruichi clashes with Nakk Le Vaar.

sub.title: Son of Darkness
sub.description: The battle between Nakk Le Vaar, Yoruichi and Urahara rages and Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach.

sub.title: Blood for My Bone
sub.description: Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach in a battle that will shape the fate of the Three Worlds.

sub.title: The Perfect Crimson
sub.description: Gerard's ability remains unbroken, while Ichigo endures Yhwach's fierce assault.

sub.title: Defend You
sub.description: Confronting Yhwach, Ichigo awakens the power of the Hollow deep within, becoming Demi-Hollowfied.

sub.title: The End
sub.description: The battle between Uryu and Haschwalth intensifies and nears its conclusion.

sub.title: The End 2
sub.description: Ichigo's Bankai fails to reach Yhwach as he falls into despair and is depowered. Ishida allies with the soul reapers and Arrancar to counter Yhwach's Seed of Destruction to save the Three Worlds.

sub.title: The End Two World
sub.description: Ichigo, with his Bankai broken and Zanpakuto shattered, sinks into the depths of despair, unable even to stand. As the flame of his courage dims, his past enemies appear in front of him.
